name: gtrendsR
what_it_holds: R package providing functions to query and display Google Trends data (interest over time/region/related). This is the R-ecosystem equivalent of pytrends and is the dependency trendecon builds on top of.
why_useful: Only relevant if the team wants an R-native Trends client (e.g. to pair with R-based nowcasting repos like adaptive-nowcasting or the Jordan BSTS repo found above); otherwise redundant with pytrends.
duplicate_of_holding: functional duplicate of pytrends in a different language
themes: Google Trends tooling and datasets: pytrends, gtab anchored trends, historical trends archives, trends nowcasting repos
why_all: Only relevant if the team wants an R-native Trends client (e.g. to pair with R-based nowcasting repos like adaptive-nowcasting or the Jordan BSTS repo found above); otherwise redundant with pytrends.
Only useful if the team wants an R-based pull path (e.g. to reuse trendecon directly); otherwise duplicative of pytrends-family tools already available in Python.

why_useful: Minor/low-effort alternative for daily-granularity pulls; lower quality signal than the more-starred longtrends/GoogleTrends-Scraper repos but worth noting as another implementation of the same idea.
